description:
analyze_entry (jobs/semantic.rs:505-520) builds its lookup key as (entry_id, values.clone()) before asking the walk table, then clones the scope again as the local it mutates. SemanticValues is two ordered collections; sites jobs/semantic.rs:46 (6,608) and :60 (3,136).

Change: the table is asked through a borrow of the scope (for example a table per entry keyed by SemanticValues), so a hit copies nothing; a miss makes the fewest copies the walk needs (the mutated local and the stored key). If hits are rare and a miss cannot drop a copy, close with the finding.
